title: Plan scope is mechanical test-isolation only
body: F001 is the entire plan. The fix is a two-line addition to the autouse fixture (DONTPANIC_HOME + JARVIS_HOME redirect) plus a regression test. No production code changes. No agent-conventions schema changes. No resolver changes — the gap is purely conftest hygiene. This is the minimum surface that closes the leak D007 of plan 2026-05-08-003 memo'd.

title: goal_type omitted; no objective_contract
body: This plan does not restore an operator-facing journey (parity) and does not introduce new product capability (new_feature). It tightens test infrastructure that should have been complete from the start. Setting goal_type=null avoids triggering the F2 close gate's objective_contract evidence path, which would over-engineer ledger artifacts for a two-line conftest fix. The audit trail is the F001 acceptance + the orchestrate sweep evidence under raw pytest.

title: Lock ceremony is appropriate here, not skipped
body: Unlike plan 2026-05-08-003 (which had to skip lock because the lock gate consumed surfaces F001/F002/F003 of THAT plan were repairing), this plan does NOT touch the F003 sufficiency-auditor surface or the F002 pre_impl auto-clear surface or the F001 reconciliation surface. `dontpanic plan lock` should run cleanly. If the operator chooses manual-direct execution anyway for speed, that's a tradeoff but not a correctness requirement.

title: Plan closed: F001 verified green, status flipped to completed
body: F001 landed as a +9 line conftest delta (2 setenv calls + docstring expansion) plus a 5-test regression module. Baseline reproduction confirmed first: 50 of 102 tests in test_completion_dispatch.py + test_sufficiency_auditor.py + test_completion_gate.py failed under raw pytest before the fix. After the conftest patch all 102 pass under raw pytest, and the full orchestrate sweep is 1529 passed / 7 skipped / 0 failed under raw pytest — the first sweep that does NOT require JARVIS_HOME=/tmp/x DONTPANIC_HOME=/tmp/y env-var hygiene since the global-config consultation surface was added. Closes the D007 follow-up flagged in plan 2026-05-08-003 + the feedback memo `feedback_orchestrate_test_isolation_global_config.md`. No agent-conventions schema bump, no production code changes outside the test isolation surface.
